description: Land Acquisition - Walakanda, Kirinda Puhulwella D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, their boundaries, extents, and current claimants. The content is exclusively focused on land matters (acquisition and property descriptions), fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related administrative matters.
